headline: Session done — sweet spot bike executed clean, exactly as prescribed
summary: Indoor ride delivered 3x10min at 155bpm avg (target 150-160), landing right in the middle of the prescribed band with clean HRR (23bpm recovery in 60s) and RPE 4/feel 1 — an easy, well-tolerated session. Load logged at 58 vs the 55 estimate, essentially a match; note this is HR-based load (HRSS) on a bike day, so it's already a reasonably honest number, not one of the undercounted interval types. Zero impact cost, zero ITB relevance — exactly the low-risk aerobic lever this was designed to be.
flags: HRV this morning spiked to 79, well above the recent 42-67 range — likely rebound/noise after a hard rebuild week rather than a new baseline; don't overreact to it tomorrow.
Tuesday's threshold run (i189067278) was strong: 6x4min at 173bpm, RPE 4, feel 1, compliance 97% — that's the key quality session for the week and it landed well.
suggestedChange: None needed — session executed to plan. Worth just double-checking tomorrow's prescription lines up with the Wk2 Saturday mountain long run (Presolana, ~600m D+) given today's very high HRV reading — if it holds tomorrow morning too, that's a green light, not just noise.
